Hi all —

Quick read of the term sheet: overall looks standard. A couple of notes from our side: 

- Payment schedule: CloudScale prefers 50% upfront, 50% on completion. Redwood's proposal (invoice after completion) will need an exception sign-off from finance — otherwise we suggest the split above.
- Lead ownership: define SLA for lead handoff (e.g., leads sent to owning rep within 48 hours) and which CRM will own canonical lead records.
- Usage rights: clarify that co-branded assets may be used by both parties for 12 months for demand gen.

If Redwood is okay with the 50/50 split but wants invoice-on-completion, we can accept that if Redwood signs a payment guarantee addendum. I'll let Rishi advise whether that's acceptable legally.

Thanks,
Priya
Sr. Counsel, CloudScale

Hi Priya / team —

Thanks for the quick read. From Redwood legal's side: 

- We're fine with 50/50 cost split. However, Redwood cannot agree to 50% upfront payments for MDF without finance sign-off; our standard is invoice-on-completion for co-marketing MDFs. If CloudScale needs upfront, we can accept 50% upfront with a short payment guarantee (one-page addendum) and milestone language.
- Lead SLA: 48 hours for lead handoff is acceptable. We'll propose stating that each company will own leads originating from their booth traffic and registration forms; shared leads from joint pages will be routed based on lead scoring (to be agreed).
- Asset usage: 12 months is OK. We recommend adding a clause about brand approvals (48-hour review) for co-branded assets.

Marissa — I'll send a 1-pager addendum template by EOD Wednesday that you can attach to the term sheet.

Rishi
General Counsel
Redwood Inference
